governance.decisionForum: King’s Edge Portfolio Board, with the team’s organisational, workforce and professional-practice arrangements governed through the relevant Digital and IT forums.
governance.decisionScope: Material decisions about the team’s remit; the four funded Year One posts and their grades, start dates and recurrent implications; whether the optional 1.0 FTE sandwich-year Junior Full-Stack Engineer is added as supervised augmentation; whether solution architecture is covered within the Senior Backend & Integration Engineer post or separately; the small protected Business Analysis and DevOps/platform allocations; leadership and decision rights; demand intake and prioritisation; the evidence the first year must generate about team shape and institutional capability; any material increase in first-year Hub scope that would compete with the King’s Edge roadmap; product and delivery practices; interfaces with specialist Digital and IT functions; evidence-based decisions to expand the team; handover criteria; and enduring institutional ownership.
governance.businessAsUsualOwner: TBC – Digital and IT product development capability owner
governance.businessAsUsualOwnershipNote: The capability is expected to sit within Digital and IT. The Year One funded core is 4.0 FTE across four explicit posts: 1.0 FTE Senior Backend & Integration Engineer, 1.0 FTE Middleweight Full-Stack Engineer, 1.0 FTE Product & Service Designer and 1.0 FTE QA Engineer. Mark Peace is Product Owner. The Product & Service Designer combines UX/UI, service design, prototyping and user research. The current staffing cost envelope is £201,000 for approximately November 2026 to June 2027, pending Digital and IT grading and start-date validation. Outside the funded core, the working assumption is deliberately lean: approximately 0.2 FTE protected Business Analysis during the main discovery period and approximately 0.2 FTE DevOps/platform support, with up to approximately 0.2 FTE solution architecture only if the senior engineering post cannot carry that function. Product quality assurance sits with the QA Engineer; specialist security, privacy, accessibility, data, architecture assurance and service-management input is drawn from existing institutional functions when required rather than represented as standing fractional posts. A 1.0 FTE sandwich-year Junior Full-Stack Engineer may be added as optional supervised augmentation but does not replace the middleweight engineer and is not part of the current baseline. The enduring organisational home, recurrent staffing, professional leadership and relationship to the Digital Student Experience Hub product and platform ownership under 4.1.2 should be confirmed as the operating model is proven. King’s Edge remains the principal substantive product demand and the September 2027 Hub is a focused first live release.
